meta.rule: the sources named in the brief, each checked for API, licence and robots.txt on 2026-10-04; written by hand in tools/portals/national.mjs SOURCES

sources.name: DfT road traffic statistics: count points and annual average daily flow (AADF)
DfT road safety data (STATS19): collisions, last 5 years
sources.sensitivity: personal injury collisions: aggregated to LSOA x year x severity; no collision rows, no casualty or vehicle tables

sources.name: police.uk street-level crime (API crimes-street, 12 months)
sources.sensitivity: positions are police.uk anonymised snap points; aggregated to snap point x category over 12 months, and month x category; no crime ids, no outcomes per crime

sources.name: DESNZ sub-national electricity and gas consumption by LSOA and MSOA (2010-2024)
Ofcom Connected Nations: broadband and mobile coverage by postcode and output area
sources.reason: www.ofcom.org.uk answers 403 to scripted requests, robots.txt included (2026-10-04); not fetched through other routes

sources.name: Nomis API (ONS labour market and census datasets)
sources.reason: robots.txt disallows /api/v01/dataset/ and /query/ for every agent; census tables taken from the bulk downloads instead (../nomis/)

sources.name: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data
HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
sources.reason: held: tools/registry-inspire.mjs (source hmlr-inspire); planning.data.gov.uk re-serves it as title-boundary

sources.name: FSA food hygiene ratings
Historic England open data (NHLE, Heritage at Risk, APAs)
sources.reason: scheduled monuments and APAs held (registry/sources/museums); listed buildings and Heritage at Risk harvested from planning.data.gov.uk (../pdg/)

sources.name: EA Flood Map for Planning (flood zones 2 and 3)
sources.reason: harvested from planning.data.gov.uk (../pdg/flood-risk-zone/); EA spatial flood defences held (ea-defences)

sources.name: OS Open UPRN and Open Linked Identifiers
OS Open Greenspace
OS Open Names (GB CSV)
OS Open Rivers (GB GeoPackage)
OS Open USRN, Open Roads, Built Up Areas
sources.reason: GB downloads of 0.3 to 1 GB; the container had about 2 GB of free disk on 2026-10-04: one product at a time, zone extract only, the download deleted after reading

sources.name: Coal Authority mining reporting areas
British Geological Survey datasets
sources.licence: BGS terms per product (OGL for some, commercial for others)
sources.reason: 4,128 BGS records on data.gov.uk have no licence field; BGS Geology 625k/50k licences to be read per product before use

sources.name: English Indices of Deprivation 2025 by LSOA
Energy Performance Certificates (domestic and non-domestic)
